title: top-up: CI cargo check scanner
definition: module added to worker/deno/lib/ after the recorded security-sweep slices: ci_cargo_checks.ts reads the target repository's workflow YAML as data (never executes it), derives the cargo clippy and test-compile commands CI runs, and refuses working directories that are absolute, contain .. or hold expressions (#4630); gate_infra_release.ts (PR #4896 review) counts fleet-authored release markers on a PR through gh, validating its key against an allow-list before it reaches a jq expression
